constraints: jsonString must be well-formed JSON, otherwise a parsing error is generated.
Starting with 4D 16 R4, this command can usually be replaced by JSON Parse returning a collection, which allows mixed-type data (more flexible than a typed 4D array).

overloadMerges.note: Fixed 'array' direction to 'out' (draft defaulted to 'in'); the parameter table marks it with col2 '←' as the receiving output array.

params.name: array
params.description: Array containing result from parsing of JSON string

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Deserializes a JSON-formatted string into the elements of a 4D array, whose declared type determines how the values are coerced.
